title: Candidate R8 Convergence Extrapolation Correction and Iteration Budget Qualification
finding: Candidate Package 171-R8 mathematical specification verified and convergence extrapolation corrected: max_outer=120 leaves only 31 relaxation iterations after trigger at outer 89, yielding delta_d=4.15e-5 which fails the required delta_d<=1.0e-5 threshold. With conservative contraction rate rho=0.84, crossing 1.0e-5 requires 40 relaxation iterations (total 129 iterations). Therefore, max_outer is budgeted to 140 iterations, providing 51 relaxation iterations (11 margin iterations) and projecting delta_d=1.27e-6<=1.0e-5. Runtime at 140 iterations is 1.33h, well within the 8h PBS limit (83.4% headroom). Compound trigger (|A_k|<=500, |Delta A_k|<=10, Delta A^+=0, N=3) and divergence/healing safeguards verified; frozen UEL and physical acceptance thresholds strictly preserved.
